scope: Completed controlled-artifact campaign, unchanged R4 production candidate. Read-only evidence extraction; no rerun. All failed gate evidence retained. Native follow phases are separate processes; RSS is not summed. Latency percentiles are histogram upper bounds.

backlog.definition: materialized generated records minus sink accepted unique events; includes at most one bounded producer batch before append

limits: one append-only JSONL source; no rotation, truncation, symlink or file-discovery coverage
source/state use the selected output filesystem; tmpfs changes fsync costs
single bounded HTTP sink process; histogram is producer-to-acceptance latency, not network-only latency
collector CPU includes controller threads, excluding separate writer/sink processes
same-state rejection is checked while idle; different-state concurrency is not exercised
controlled accept-before-503 on one event batch models at-least-once replay, not arbitrary kill/crash timing or server deduplication
Rust collector only; there is no Go ingest feature to compare

latency.overflow_note: null percentile means empty histogram or above final finite bin

sink.duplicate_policy: exact replay after injected accept-before-503 is expected at-least-once delivery; no server deduplication is performed

original_follow_comparison.interpretation: Original single follow run met pacing with max lag0.031s; controlled run missed0.25s pacing tolerance at0.503s despite average~5000/s and all300000 records accepted. Controlled backlog/latency were substantially higher. No causal claim or selective replacement of either run.

identical_copy_rss.interpretation: Initial3pairs all ran baseline-labelled original before final-labelled byte-identical copy and observed about1.3MiB less RSS in the copy, primarily file-backed residency. Later6pairs balanced order3each did not reproduce that gap: both copies were about8.7–9.0MB statusRSS. The initial result justified checking artifact residency sensitivity but is not a reproducible fixed offset, and neither series establishes a kernel/page-cache root cause.

limits: Compatibility success does not override a failed resource or producer-pacing gate.

Controlled follow producer pacing failed; do not advertise this run as a successful paced 5000/s sustained benchmark. All300000 events were ultimately accepted with content/order/checkpoints verified.
Fault injection tests are controlled at-least-once replay/split checks, not arbitrary crash durability or exactly-once delivery.
Charged storage bytes and write calls do not measure physical SSD wear.
RSS snapshots are interrupted steady-state diagnostics, not lifetime-peak measurements; neither copy-control series establishes a kernel/page-cache root cause.

artifact_policy.reason: Three paired interrupted RSS snapshots showed ~1.3MiB executable-file residency difference for byte-identical R4 copies. Repeat native measurements with uniform artifact materialization. Preserve original results and failed gate. Underlying kernel/page-cache cause not established.
artifact_policy.method: Serial read/write of 65536-byte blocks into fresh files, flush+fsync, chmod0755, SHA256 full reads source/copy; same policy for both Rust artifacts and Go. No cache dropping or system tuning. Existing warmup and randomized paired runs retained.
